title: MobileSecurityUserMetric - Data API
description: Represents the metrics for users who have Enhanced Mobile Security policies enforced. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

MetricsDate.description: The date the metrics were collected.

UserCount.description: The number of users who have mobile security policies enforced.

special_access_rules: Accessing this object requires the Enhanced Mobile App Security add-on subscriptions and the Enforce Enhanced Mobile App Security user permission.
usage:
A user with the Manage Enhanced Mobile App Security permission can run this SOQL query.

SELECT MetricsDate, UserCount

FROM MobileSecurityUserMetric

ORDER BY MetricsDate DESC
